---Validation
SELECT FXD_CRNCY_CODE, VAR_CRNCY_CODE, RTLIST_DATE, RATECODE, BANK_ID, COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE_bu_20230613 WHERE FILE_NAME LIKE '%20230208%' 
    GROUP BY FXD_CRNCY_CODE, VAR_CRNCY_CODE, RTLIST_DATE, RATECODE, BANK_ID HAVING COUNT(*) > 2

SELECT FILE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS [Record Count] FROM BUSC.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE 
    ---WHERE FILE_NAME LIKE '%20230127%' OR FILE_NAME LIKE '%20230208%' 
    GROUP BY FILE_NAME

---Backup
SELECT * INTO BUSC.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE_bu_20230613 FROM BUSC.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE
---Truncate Table
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE
---Get Columns
Select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_name = 'GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE' and table_schema = 'busc'
